preconditions: Polled once per frame from the game post-main-loop caller 0x0042D8A0; session or menu is in a restartable state.
byte_7CE254 selects the path: non-zero drives the sub_485B90 restart decision, zero drives the input-action map scan.
Restart-request flags byte_7CE25D / byte_7CE25E are consumed and cleared on the branch that reads them.
postconditions: Returns 4 for a mini-restart request after an optional vehicle-slot cleanup pass.
Returns 6 for a full-restart request, also returned when sub_485B90 returns -1 or 3.
When no early return fires, returns the session-type global dword_7C569C as the effective state request.
byte_7CE25D and byte_7CE25E are cleared to 0 when their respective branches execute.
side_effects: Post-increments dword_7CE250 and passes the pre-increment value to sub_485B90.
Calls FieldCopy_c330 (0x004BC330) on each of the first dword_5C329C vehicle pointers at dword_7C54F0 advanced by 0x4034 bytes when dword_7C56A4 == 7.
Calls SessionStateTransition (0x004EF5A0) on dword_7C54E8 + 0xC with two zero arguments when ScoringGateCheck passes and the dword at dword_7C54E8 + 0x32C8 equals 1.
Countdown state machine: when byte_7CE269 is set, subtracts dbl_8AFE98 from the float at dword_7CE26C; on result <= 0 clears byte_7CE269, zeroes dword_7CE26C, and sets dword_7CE258 to 1.
Sets dword_7C569C to 6 when dword_7CE264 == 1 on the init path; otherwise calls ConditionalInitGuard (0x004A0CF0).

When byte_7CE254 is zero, scans word_7CB21C (count dword_7CB218); for each element equal to 1, calls ByteFieldExtractorWithShift (0x00404F00) on dword_5EA43C; on success sets dword_7C569C to 6 and calls MainMenuTransition (0x00404F30), otherwise sets dword_7CE258 to 1.
Calls sub_404B60 with the address of dword_5EA43C.
Calls sub_4A0CB0 at the end of the per-poll housekeeping.

disputes.description: Return values 4 and 6 are read as mini/full restart directives, but the numeric meaning is inferred from the caller 0x0042D8A0 context and the function's own branch structure; the packet carries no string or import evidence that names the constants.
byte_7CE260 participates in the full-restart OR-guard alongside byte_7CE25E but is never cleared by this function; its write site and clearing site live outside this packet.
Raw C is a parameter-less global-state poll; no this pointer and no constructor evidence, so no owning object type is claimed. State is held in module globals, not a struct.

Unit: with byte_7CE25E set, assert return 6 and byte_7CE25E cleared.
Integration: stub sub_485B90 to return -1, 3, and 4; assert returns 6, 6, and 4 respectively.
